title: Thai-Style Yogurt Dumplings
description: A refreshing twist on traditional Thai cuisine, these yogurt dumplings are a perfect snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine dumplings, yoghurt, and portuguese. Mix until smooth and well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, stir in effervescent (soda water) to give the mixture a light and airy texture.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar or a few slices of fresh fruit, if desired.
